valuation.method: Forward EPS x justified P/E at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), viewing FY2028 (year ending March 2028) non-GAAP diluted EPS, the fiscal year that is current at that date. Listing basis: ARM trades as an ADS in USD; the Citibank depositary notice (Sep 2025) and the 20-F deposit agreement set the ratio at 1 ADS = 1 ordinary share, so ordinary-share values need no conversion and the targets are per ADS. No FX conversion: the listing and reporting currency are both USD. Base EPS is the FY2028 consensus of $3.08 (Yahoo Finance EPS trend column for 7 days before 2026-11-17, about 2026-11-10, pre-cutoff; the 2026-11-17 snapshot shows $3.09). Bear and bull EPS are the low ($2.65) and high ($3.95) FY2028 estimates from the 2026-11-17 Yahoo snapshot, which post-dates the reference close and is used only for the range bounds. Consensus is a provider estimate, not company guidance. Q2 FY27 revenue was $1.44B (+27%); non-GAAP diluted EPS $0.52 is the actual shown on Yahoo Finance's earnings history, and the 44.2% operating margin comes from a secondary summary (Zacks); the company letter was not opened; Q3 FY27 guidance is revenue $1.54B +/- $50M and non-GAAP EPS $0.56 +/- $0.04 (secondary source, Zacks). Share count: about 1.07B shares (pipeline shares_used); Q2 non-GAAP net income of $566M at $0.52 implies about 1.09B diluted shares, a derived figure, not a reported one; the difference is inside the EPS consensus range and is not separately adjusted. Release time (16:05 ET) is approximated from the 17:00 ET webcast start and is not verified against the release timestamp.

bear.driver: Royalty growth lags licensing (Q2 FY27 royalty revenue $670M, +8% y/y, against licensing +50%), the AGI CPU ramp slips past its FY27-FY28 $2B outlook, and investors stop paying a premium multiple for a stock trading near 84x FY2027 EPS.
bear.assumption: EPS $2.65 (low end of FY2028 estimates) at 40x

base.driver: Licensing and royalty growth track the Q3 FY27 guide (revenue $1.54B, non-GAAP EPS $0.56) and consensus FY2028 EPS; AGI CPU delivers a meaningful share of the up-to-$2B FY27-FY28 outlook. Today's close is about 84x FY2027 and 62x FY2028 EPS; the 60x base is about a 29% de-rating from the 84x current-fiscal-year multiple, as EPS growth slows from roughly 36%.

bull.driver: AGI CPU exceeds the $2B outlook and data center royalties keep compounding (doubling y/y in Q2), with Arm-based server share above 60% as guided; the market keeps a growth multiple on FY2028 EPS at the top of the estimate range.
bull.assumption: EPS $3.95 (high end of FY2028 estimates) at 75x

valuation.implied_by_close: The close of $190.53 is 61.9x FY2028 consensus EPS of $3.08 and 83.9x FY2027 consensus of $2.27. The Yahoo aggregate mean target of $272.43 (40 analysts, provider-published) implies 88x FY2028 EPS, or about $4.54 of EPS at 60x (+47% above the base EPS). The nine named targets dated on or before the close (Barclays $325, KeyBanc $300, Piper $270, Evercore $326, Mizuho $330, UBS $270, TD Cowen $250, Susquehanna $320, RBC $300) average about $299, or about 97x FY2028 EPS at $3.08.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $3.08 (about 1.6 pp of price return). A $0.10 change in FY2028 EPS moves the base target by $6.00 (about 3.1 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Royalty revenue growth (Q2 FY27 +8% y/y, against licensing +50%) together with the AGI CPU revenue run-rate against the up-to-$2B FY27-FY28 outlook and the non-GAAP operating margin (44.2% in Q2). Base case needs royalty growth to hold while Q3 FY27 EPS lands near $0.56.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q3 FY2027 results (quarter ending Dec 2026), expected early February 2027 (provider estimate of 2027-02-03; confirm on the company IR calendar).

analyst_notes: Nine named brokers have dated calls on or before the reference close, and the named sample skews bullish: its mean target of about $299 sits above the Yahoo aggregate mean of $272.43 across 40 analysts. Seven brokers changed or reaffirmed targets on 2026-11-05 after the Q2 print (Mizuho $400 to $330, UBS $320 to $270, TD Cowen $350 to $250, RBC $340 to $300, Barclays $360 to $325; Evercore $326 and Susquehanna $320 with no prior shown), Piper reaffirmed $270 on 2026-11-12, and KeyBanc raised to $300 from $170 on 2026-05-07. No row documents a 12-month horizon, so no weighted analyst target can be formed; the named mean is unweighted, and the Morgan Stanley Hold dated 2026-11-17 is excluded as after the cutoff.
